Rate fences

Source: vignettes/rate-fences.Rmd
rate-fences.Rmd
library(golfops)
fences <- peoria_rate_fences()
card <- peoria_rate_card()
products <- unique(card[, c("facility", "product", "holes")])

lookup <- function(segment, day, daypart) {
  rows <- card[card$segment == segment & card$day == day & card$daypart == daypart, ]
  key <- paste(products$facility, products$product)
  rows$price[match(key, paste(rows$facility, rows$product))]
}

show_prices <- function(frame, price_cols) {
  for (col in price_cols) {
    frame[[col]] <- ifelse(is.na(frame[[col]]), "N/A", sprintf("%.2f", frame[[col]]))
  }
  frame
}

These are the posted prices on the Peoria weekday and weekend sheet, version 2. Ten products are on the sheet. Kellogg, Madison, and Newman each post an 18-hole course, a front nine, and a back nine. Kellogg also posts Executive, a nine-hole course. The course key on the sheet spells Newman as Neuman. The tables below use Newman.

A blank cell is a fence the sheet leaves empty. The sheet has no count of rounds, so it has no revenue. Quantity from the earlier fictional card is gone.

Segments

Fences on the Peoria sheet. Twilight is a daypart on the adult green fee. Blank means every cell in that column is empty.
Segment What is priced Rule On the sheet
Adult Green fee for one round Weekday and weekend each have an adult green fee on every product. Posted
Adult twilight Green fee for one round Posted on Kellogg Executive, Kellogg Back 9, and Madison Back 9, for weekday and weekend. The other products leave the cell blank. Posted
Senior Green fee for one round Weekday and weekend each have a senior green fee on every product. Posted
Junior Green fee for one round Posted on Kellogg Executive and on each 18-hole course. The weekday fee and the weekend fee are the same. Front 9 and Back 9 leave the cell blank. Posted
Junior twilight Green fee for one round The sheet has the column. Every cell is blank. Blank
Military Green fee for one round The sheet has a weekday column and a weekend column. Every cell is blank. Blank
Adult with cart Green fee and cart for one adult round A posted adult price that includes a cart. On a weekday it equals that product’s adult green fee plus its cart fee. On a weekend it is its own posted price. Posted
Holiday 18 with cart Green fee and cart for one 18-hole round The column header names a Saturday and Sunday holiday rate for 18 holes with a cart, from May 11 through September 29. Every cell is blank. Blank
Cart Cart for one round Eighteen-hole courses are $17. Nine-hole products are $12. The sheet does not split the cart fee by weekday or weekend. Posted
Pull cart Pull cart for one round Five dollars on every product. Posted
Club per club One club One dollar per club on every product. Posted
Club rental Club rental Kellogg 18 and Newman 18 are $20. Every other product, including Madison 18, is $10. Posted

Weekday

Adult, senior, and junior are walking green fees. Twilight is the adult twilight green fee. Adult with cart is the posted price for an adult round that includes a cart. On a weekday that price equals the adult green fee plus the cart fee, on every product.

Twilight is posted on Kellogg Executive, Kellogg Back 9, and Madison Back 9. On Kellogg Executive the twilight green fee is $30.00 and the day rate is $24.00. Carts and clubs

The cart fee follows the number of holes: $17.00 on an 18-hole course and $12.00 on a nine-hole product. The pull cart is $5.00 and a single club is $1.00, on every product. The club-rental fee is $20.00 at Kellogg 18 and Newman 18, and $10.00 on the other products, including Madison 18.

Cart and club fees, in dollars. The sheet does not split these by weekday or weekend.

The card has 114 posted prices. Junior twilight, military, and the holiday 18-hole rate with a cart are columns on the sheet with no prices in them. The holiday header names May 11 through September 29.

A played round can still add fences. An adult weekday round with a cart is already one posted price. A senior round with a cart is the senior green fee plus the cart fee, and that sum is not its own row. The mix of rounds across these fences needs a season of rounds labeled with the product, the day, and the daypart. This sheet does not have that season.
